第十一章：并发编程详解

11.1 线程基础

#include <thread>
#include <iostream>
#include <chrono>

/**
 * C++11线程库
 */

// 普通函数作为线程函数
void threadFunction(int id) {
    std::cout << "Thread " << id << " running\n";
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));
}

// 函数对象
class ThreadFunctor {
public:
    void operator()(int id) {
        std::cout << "Functor thread " << id << "\n";
    }
};

void thread_basics() {
    // 创建线程
    std::thread t1(threadFunction, 1);
    
    // 使用函数对象
    ThreadFunctor functor;
    std::thread t2(functor, 2);
    
    // 使用lambda
    std::thread t3([](int id) {
        std::cout << "Lambda thread " << id << "\n";
    }, 3);
    
    // 获取线程ID
    std::cout << "Thread ID: " << t1.get_id() << std::endl;
    
    // 获取硬件并发数
    unsigned int n = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
    std::cout << "Hardware threads: " << n << std::endl;
    
    // 等待线程结束
    t1.join();
    t2.join();
    t3.join();
    
    // detach：线程独立运行
    std::thread t4(threadFunction, 4);
    t4.detach();  // 不再等待
}

11.2 互斥锁

#include <mutex>
#include <shared_mutex>

/**
 * 互斥锁（Mutex）
 */

std::mutex mtx;
int shared_data = 0;

void increment() {
    // 1. lock/unlock
    mtx.lock();
    ++shared_data;
    mtx.unlock();
    
    // 2. lock_guard：RAII风格（推荐）
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
        ++shared_data;
    }  // 自动解锁
    
    // 3. unique_lock：更灵活
    {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
        ++shared_data;
        lock.unlock();  // 可以手动解锁
        // 做其他事情
        lock.lock();    // 可以再次加锁
    }
    
    // 4. try_lock：尝试加锁
    if (mtx.try_lock()) {
        ++shared_data;
        mtx.unlock();
    }
}

/**
 * 递归锁
 */
std::recursive_mutex rec_mtx;

void recursive_function(int count) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(rec_mtx);
    if (count > 0) {
        recursive_function(count - 1);  // 可以递归加锁
    }
}

/**
 * 读写锁（C++17）
 */
std::shared_mutex rw_mtx;
int rw_data = 0;

void read_data() {
    std::shared_lock<std::shared_mutex> lock(rw_mtx);  // 共享锁
    std::cout << "Data: " << rw_data << std::endl;
}

void write_data(int value) {
    std::unique_lock<std::shared_mutex> lock(rw_mtx);  // 独占锁
    rw_data = value;
}

/**
 * 避免死锁
 */
std::mutex mtx1, mtx2;

void bad_lock_order() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock1(mtx1);
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock2(mtx2);  // 可能死锁
}

void good_lock_order() {
    // 使用std::lock同时锁定多个互斥量
    std::lock(mtx1, mtx2);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock1(mtx1, std::adopt_lock);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock2(mtx2, std::adopt_lock);
}

// C++17: scoped_lock
void best_lock_order() {
    std::scoped_lock lock(mtx1, mtx2);  // 自动避免死锁
}

11.3 条件变量

#include <condition_variable>
#include <queue>

/**
 * 条件变量（Condition Variable）
 * 线程间通信
 */

std::mutex cv_mtx;
std::condition_variable cv;
std::queue<int> data_queue;
bool finished = false;

// 生产者
void producer() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
        
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(cv_mtx);
            data_queue.push(i);
            std::cout << "Produced: " << i << std::endl;
        }
        
        cv.notify_one();  // 通知一个等待的线程
    }
    
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(cv_mtx);
        finished = true;
    }
    cv.notify_all();  // 通知所有等待的线程
}

// 消费者
void consumer() {
    while (true) {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(cv_mtx);
        
        // 等待条件满足
        cv.wait(lock, []{ return !data_queue.empty() || finished; });
        
        if (!data_queue.empty()) {
            int value = data_queue.front();
            data_queue.pop();
            lock.unlock();  // 提前解锁，提高并发
            
            std::cout << "Consumed: " << value << std::endl;
        } else if (finished) {
            break;
        }
    }
}

void condition_variable_demo() {
    std::thread t1(producer);
    std::thread t2(consumer);
    std::thread t3(consumer);
    
    t1.join();
    t2.join();
    t3.join();
}

11.4 原子操作

#include <atomic>

/**
 * 原子操作（Atomic）
 * 无锁的线程安全操作
 */

void atomic_demo() {
    std::atomic<int> counter{0};
    
    // 原子操作
    counter++;                          // 原子自增
    counter.fetch_add(5);              // 原子加法
    counter.fetch_sub(3);              // 原子减法
    int old_value = counter.exchange(100);  // 原子交换
    
    // CAS操作（Compare-And-Swap）
    int expected = 100;
    bool success = counter.compare_exchange_strong(expected, 200);
    // 如果counter == expected，则设置为200，返回true
    // 否则将expected设置为counter的当前值，返回false
    
    // 内存顺序
    counter.store(10, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    int value = counter.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    
    // 原子标志
    std::atomic_flag flag = ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;
    
    // 自旋锁实现
    while (flag.test_and_set(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        // 自旋等待
    }
    // 临界区
    flag.clear(std::memory_order_release);
}

/**
 * 无锁队列示例
 */
template<typename T>
class LockFreeQueue {
private:
    struct Node {
        T data;
        std::atomic<Node*> next;
        Node(T const& data_) : data(data_), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    
    std::atomic<Node*> head;
    std::atomic<Node*> tail;
    
public:
    LockFreeQueue() : head(new Node(T())), tail(head.load()) {}
    
    void push(T const& data) {
        Node* new_node = new Node(data);
        Node* old_tail = tail.load();
        
        while (!tail.compare_exchange_weak(old_tail, new_node)) {
            // 重试
        }
        
        old_tail->next.store(new_node);
    }
    
    bool pop(T& result) {
        Node* old_head = head.load();
        Node* next = old_head->next.load();
        
        if (next == nullptr) {
            return false;  // 队列为空
        }
        
        result = next->data;
        head.store(next);
        delete old_head;
        return true;
    }
};

11.5 future和promise

#include <future>

/**
 * future和promise
 * 异步任务的结果传递
 */

// 异步任务
int calculate() {
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(2));
    return 42;
}

void future_demo() {
    // 1. async：异步执行
    std::future<int> result = std::async(std::launch::async, calculate);
    
    std::cout << "等待结果..." << std::endl;
    int value = result.get();  // 阻塞等待结果
    std::cout << "结果: " << value << std::endl;
    
    // 2. packaged_task：打包任务
    std::packaged_task<int()> task(calculate);
    std::future<int> result2 = task.get_future();
    
    std::thread t(std::move(task));
    int value2 = result2.get();
    t.join();
    
    // 3. promise：手动设置结果
    std::promise<int> prom;
    std::future<int> fut = prom.get_future();
    
    std::thread t2([&prom]() {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));
        prom.set_value(100);  // 设置结果
    });
    
    int value3 = fut.get();
    t2.join();
    
    // 4. shared_future：多个等待者
    std::promise<int> prom2;
    std::shared_future<int> shared_fut = prom2.get_future().share();
    
    auto waiter = [](std::shared_future<int> f) {
        std::cout << "Result: " << f.get() << std::endl;
    };
    
    std::thread t3(waiter, shared_fut);
    std::thread t4(waiter, shared_fut);
    
    prom2.set_value(42);
    
    t3.join();
    t4.join();
}

第十二章：现代C++最佳实践

12.1 RAII与资源管理

/**
 * RAII（Resource Acquisition Is Initialization）
 * 资源获取即初始化
 */

// 文件句柄RAII包装
class FileHandle {
private:
    FILE* file;
    
public:
    FileHandle(const char* filename, const char* mode) 
        : file(fopen(filename, mode)) {
        if (!file) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open file");
        }
    }
    
    ~FileHandle() {
        if (file) {
            fclose(file);
        }
    }
    
    // 禁止拷贝
    FileHandle(const FileHandle&) = delete;
    FileHandle& operator=(const FileHandle&) = delete;
    
    // 允许移动
    FileHandle(FileHandle&& other) noexcept : file(other.file) {
        other.file = nullptr;
    }
    
    FileHandle& operator=(FileHandle&& other) noexcept {
        if (this != &other) {
            if (file) fclose(file);
            file = other.file;
            other.file = nullptr;
        }
        return *this;
    }
    
    FILE* get() { return file; }
};

// 锁的RAII包装
class Lock {
private:
    std::mutex& mtx;
    
public:
    Lock(std::mutex& m) : mtx(m) {
        mtx.lock();
    }
    
    ~Lock() {
        mtx.unlock();
    }
};

// 通用资源管理器
template<typename Resource, typename Deleter>
class ResourceGuard {
private:
    Resource resource;
    Deleter deleter;
    bool engaged;
    
public:
    ResourceGuard(Resource r, Deleter d) 
        : resource(r), deleter(d), engaged(true) {}
    
    ~ResourceGuard() {
        if (engaged) {
            deleter(resource);
        }
    }
    
    ResourceGuard(const ResourceGuard&) = delete;
    ResourceGuard& operator=(const ResourceGuard&) = delete;
    
    ResourceGuard(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept
        : resource(other.resource)
        , deleter(std::move(other.deleter))
        , engaged(other.engaged) {
        other.engaged = false;
    }
    
    Resource get() const { return resource; }
    void release() { engaged = false; }
};

12.2 错误处理

/**
 * 现代C++错误处理
 */

// 1. 使用异常处理错误
class FileError : public std::runtime_error {
public:
    FileError(const std::string& msg) : std::runtime_error(msg) {}
};

void readFile(const std::string& filename) {
    std::ifstream file(filename);
    if (!file.is_open()) {
        throw FileError("Cannot open file: " + filename);
    }
    // 读取文件
}

// 2. 使用std::optional表示可能不存在的值（C++17）
std::optional<int> findValue(const std::vector<int>& vec, int target) {
    auto it = std::find(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (it != vec.end()) {
        return *it;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

void optional_demo() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    
    auto result = findValue(vec, 3);
    if (result) {
        std::cout << "Found: " << *result << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Not found" << std::endl;
    }
    
    // value_or：提供默认值
    int value = findValue(vec, 10).value_or(-1);
}

// 3. 使用std::variant表示多种可能的类型（C++17）
using Result = std::variant<int, std::string, std::exception_ptr>;

Result calculate(int a, int b) {
    try {
        if (b == 0) {
            return std::string("Division by zero");
        }
        return a / b;
    } catch (...) {
        return std::current_exception();
    }
}

12.3 代码风格与约定

/**
 * C++编码规范
 */

// 1. 命名约定
class ClassName {};              // 类名：大驼峰
void functionName() {}           // 函数名：小驼峰
int variable_name;               // 变量名：蛇形命名
const int CONSTANT_VALUE = 100;  // 常量：全大写

// 2. 使用const正确性
class Point {
private:
    int x, y;
    
public:
    // const成员函数：不修改对象状态
    int getX() const { return x; }
    int getY() const { return y; }
    
    // 非const成员函数：可能修改对象
    void setX(int newX) { x = newX; }
    
    // const引用参数：不拷贝，不修改
    void print(const std::string& prefix) const {
        std::cout << prefix << ": (" << x << ", " << y << ")" << std::endl;
    }
};

// 3. 优先使用auto
void auto_usage() {
    std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>> vec;
    
    // 冗长
    for (std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>>::iterator it = vec.begin();
         it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        // ...
    }
    
    // 简洁
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        // ...
    }
    
    // 更简洁
    for (const auto& item : vec) {
        // ...
    }
}

// 4. 使用nullptr而不是NULL
void pointer_usage() {
    int* p1 = nullptr;  // C++11
    int* p2 = NULL;     // C风格（避免）
    int* p3 = 0;        // 更古老（避免）
}

// 5. 使用智能指针而不是原始指针
void smart_pointer_usage() {
    // 不好
    Widget* w = new Widget();
    // ... 可能忘记delete
    delete w;
    
    // 好
    auto w = std::make_unique<Widget>();
    // 自动管理内存
}

// 6. 使用范围for循环
void range_for_usage() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    
    // 传统方式
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    
    // 范围for（推荐）
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
}

// 7. 使用=default和=delete
class NonCopyable {
public:
    NonCopyable() = default;
    NonCopyable(const NonCopyable&) = delete;
    NonCopyable& operator=(const NonCopyable&) = delete;
};

// 8. 使用override关键字
class Base {
public:
    virtual void func() {}
};

class Derived : public Base {
public:
    void func() override {}  // 明确表示重写
    // void func() {}        // 容易出错
};

// 9. 使用强类型枚举
enum class Color { RED, GREEN, BLUE };  // 不会污染命名空间

// 10. 避免使用宏，使用constexpr
// 不好
#define MAX_SIZE 1000

// 好
constexpr int MAX_SIZE = 1000;

12.4 性能优化

/**
 * C++性能优化技巧
 */

// 1. 避免不必要的拷贝
class Widget {
    std::vector<int> data;
    
public:
    // 不好：返回拷贝
    std::vector<int> getData() {
        return data;
    }
    
    // 好：返回const引用
    const std::vector<int>& getData() const {
        return data;
    }
    
    // 移动语义
    std::vector<int> extractData() {
        return std::move(data);
    }
};

// 2. 使用reserve预分配内存
void reserve_demo() {
    std::vector<int> vec;
    vec.reserve(1000);  // 预分配空间，避免多次重新分配
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) {
        vec.push_back(i);
    }
}

// 3. 使用emplace而不是push
void emplace_demo() {
    std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>> vec;
    
    // 不好：创建临时对象，然后拷贝/移动
    vec.push_back(std::make_pair(1, "one"));
    
    // 好：直接在容器中构造
    vec.emplace_back(1, "one");
}

// 4. 使用移动语义
class BigObject {
    std::vector<int> data;
    
public:
    BigObject(size_t size) : data(size) {}
    
    // 移动构造函数
    BigObject(BigObject&& other) noexcept
        : data(std::move(other.data)) {}
    
    // 移动赋值运算符
    BigObject& operator=(BigObject&& other) noexcept {
        if (this != &other) {
            data = std::move(other.data);
        }
        return *this;
    }
};

// 5. 内联函数
inline int square(int x) {
    return x * x;  // 编译器可能内联
}

// 6. 使用constexpr进行编译期计算
constexpr int factorial(int n) {
    return n <= 1 ? 1 : n * factorial(n - 1);
}

constexpr int result = factorial(5);  // 编译期计算

// 7. 避免虚函数调用的开销
class FastClass {
    // 如果不需要多态，不使用virtual
    void func() {}  // 无虚函数开销
};

// 8. 使用合适的容器
void container_choice() {
    // 频繁随机访问：vector
    std::vector<int> vec;
    
    // 频繁插入删除：list
    std::list<int> lst;
    
    // 快速查找：unordered_map
    std::unordered_map<int, std::string> map;
    
    // 小对象集合：array
    std::array<int, 10> arr;
}

// 9. 缓存友好的数据结构
struct AoS {  // Array of Structures（不友好）
    struct Data {
        int x, y, z;
        double value;
    };
    std::vector<Data> data;
};

struct SoA {  // Structure of Arrays（友好）
    std::vector<int> x, y, z;
    std::vector<double> value;
};

// 10. 使用并行算法（C++17）
void parallel_demo() {
    std::vector<int> vec(1000000);
    
    // 串行
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
    
    // 并行
    std::sort(std::execution::par, vec.begin(), vec.end());
}

第十三章：实战项目

13.1 简单HTTP服务器

/**
 * 简单的HTTP服务器实现
 * 演示网络编程、多线程、字符串处理等
 */

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <unistd.h>

class SimpleHTTPServer {
private:
    int server_fd;
    int port;
    
public:
    SimpleHTTPServer(int port) : port(port), server_fd(-1) {}
    
    ~SimpleHTTPServer() {
        if (server_fd >= 0) {
            close(server_fd);
        }
    }
    
    bool start() {
        // 创建socket
        server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (server_fd < 0) {
            std::cerr << "Failed to create socket" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        // 设置socket选项
        int opt = 1;
        setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
        
        // 绑定地址
        sockaddr_in address;
        address.sin_family = AF_INET;
        address.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
        address.sin_port = htons(port);
        
        if (bind(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&address, sizeof(address)) < 0) {
            std::cerr << "Bind failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        // 监听
        if (listen(server_fd, 10) < 0) {
            std::cerr << "Listen failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        std::cout << "Server started on port " << port << std::endl;
        return true;
    }
    
    void run() {
        while (true) {
            sockaddr_in client_addr;
            socklen_t client_len = sizeof(client_addr);
            
            int client_fd = accept(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&client_addr, &client_len);
            if (client_fd < 0) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // 创建新线程处理请求
            std::thread(&SimpleHTTPServer::handleClient, this, client_fd).detach();
        }
    }
    
private:
    void handleClient(int client_fd) {
        char buffer[4096] = {0};
        read(client_fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
        
        // 解析HTTP请求
        std::string request(buffer);
        std::istringstream iss(request);
        std::string method, path, protocol;
        iss >> method >> path >> protocol;
        
        std::cout << method << " " << path << std::endl;
        
        // 生成HTTP响应
        std::string response = generateResponse(path);
        write(client_fd, response.c_str(), response.length());
        
        close(client_fd);
    }
    
    std::string generateResponse(const std::string& path) {
        std::string body = R"(
            <!DOCTYPE html>
            <html>
            <head><title>Simple HTTP Server</title></head>
            <body>
                <h1>Welcome to Simple HTTP Server</h1>
                <p>Path: )" + path + R"(</p>
            </body>
            </html>
        )";
        
        std::ostringstream oss;
        oss << "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n";
        oss << "Content-Type: text/html\r\n";
        oss << "Content-Length: " << body.length() << "\r\n";
        oss << "\r\n";
        oss << body;
        
        return oss.str();
    }
};

// 使用示例
int main() {
    SimpleHTTPServer server(8080);
    if (server.start()) {
        server.run();
    }
    return 0;
}

13.2 线程池实现

/**
 * 线程池实现
 * 演示并发编程、任务队列、RAII等
 */

#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <queue>
#include <functional>
#include <future>

class ThreadPool {
private:
    std::vector<std::thread> workers;
    std::queue<std::function<void()>> tasks;
    
    std::mutex queue_mutex;
    std::condition_variable condition;
    bool stop;
    
public:
    ThreadPool(size_t num_threads) : stop(false) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < num_threads; ++i) {
            workers.emplace_back([this] {
                while (true) {
                    std::function<void()> task;
                    
                    {
                        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(queue_mutex);
                        condition.wait(lock, [this] {
                            return stop || !tasks.empty();
                        });
                        
                        if (stop && tasks.empty()) {
                            return;
                        }
                        
                        task = std::move(tasks.front());
                        tasks.pop();
                    }
                    
                    task();
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    ~ThreadPool() {
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(queue_mutex);
            stop = true;
        }
        
        condition.notify_all();
        
        for (std::thread& worker : workers) {
            worker.join();
        }
    }
    
    template<typename F, typename... Args>
    auto enqueue(F&& f, Args&&... args) 
        -> std::future<typename std::result_of<F(Args...)>::type> {
        
        using return_type = typename std::result_of<F(Args...)>::type;
        
        auto task = std::make_shared<std::packaged_task<return_type()>>(
            std::bind(std::forward<F>(f), std::forward<Args>(args)...)
        );
        
        std::future<return_type> res = task->get_future();
        
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(queue_mutex);
            
            if (stop) {
                throw std::runtime_error("enqueue on stopped ThreadPool");
            }
            
            tasks.emplace([task]() { (*task)(); });
        }
        
        condition.notify_one();
        return res;
    }
};

// 使用示例
void thread_pool_demo() {
    ThreadPool pool(4);
    
    std::vector<std::future<int>> results;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        results.emplace_back(
            pool.enqueue([i] {
                std::cout << "Task " << i << " running on thread " 
                          << std::this_thread::get_id() << std::endl;
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));
                return i * i;
            })
        );
    }
    
    for (auto& result : results) {
        std::cout << "Result: " << result.get() << std::endl;
    }
}

13.3 智能指针实现

/**
 * 简化版unique_ptr实现
 * 演示RAII、移动语义、模板编程等
 */

template<typename T>
class MyUniquePtr {
private:
    T* ptr;
    
public:
    // 构造函数
    explicit MyUniquePtr(T* p = nullptr) : ptr(p) {}
    
    // 析构函数
    ~MyUniquePtr() {
        delete ptr;
    }
    
    // 禁止拷贝
    MyUniquePtr(const MyUniquePtr&) = delete;
    MyUniquePtr& operator=(const MyUniquePtr&) = delete;
    
    // 移动构造
    MyUniquePtr(MyUniquePtr&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
        other.ptr = nullptr;
    }
    
    // 移动赋值
    MyUniquePtr& operator=(MyUniquePtr&& other) noexcept {
        if (this != &other) {
            delete ptr;
            ptr = other.ptr;
            other.ptr = nullptr;
        }
        return *this;
    }
    
    // 解引用
    T& operator*() const { return *ptr; }
    T* operator->() const { return ptr; }
    
    // 获取原始指针
    T* get() const { return ptr; }
    
    // 释放所有权
    T* release() {
        T* old_ptr = ptr;
        ptr = nullptr;
        return old_ptr;
    }
    
    // 重置指针
    void reset(T* p = nullptr) {
        delete ptr;
        ptr = p;
    }
    
    // bool转换
    explicit operator bool() const {
        return ptr != nullptr;
    }
};

// 工厂函数
template<typename T, typename... Args>
MyUniquePtr<T> make_my_unique(Args&&... args) {
    return MyUniquePtr<T>(new T(std::forward<Args>(args)...));
}

常见问题FAQ

Q1: C++和C有什么区别？

A: C++是C的超集，增加了面向对象、泛型编程、异常处理等特性，但保持了C的高效性。

Q2: 应该学习哪个C++标准？

A: 建议从C++11开始学习，这是现代C++的分水岭，然后逐步了解C++14/17/20的新特性。

Q3: 智能指针应该什么时候使用？

A: 几乎总是使用智能指针管理动态内存，默认使用unique_ptr，需要共享所有权时使用shared_ptr。

Q4: 什么时候使用引用，什么时候使用指针？

A: 优先使用引用。只有在需要可选参数、需要改变指向对象、需要多态容器时才使用指针。

Q5: 如何避免内存泄漏？

A: 使用RAII原则，使用智能指针，使用容器管理动态内存，避免手动new/delete。

Q6: C++的性能优势在哪里？

A: 零开销抽象、编译时计算、内存控制、无垃圾回收开销、可以直接操作硬件。

Q7: 如何提高C++编程水平？

A: 多读优秀代码、多写项目、参与开源、学习设计模式、关注新标准、参与社区讨论。

C++是一门强大而复杂的语言，掌握它需要时间和耐心。但一旦掌握，你将拥有：

第十四章：网络编程详解

14.1 Socket编程基础

/**
 * Socket编程基础
 * TCP/IP网络通信
 */

#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <iostream>

/**
 * TCP服务器
 */
class TCPServer {
private:
    int server_fd;
    int port;
    
public:
    TCPServer(int port) : port(port), server_fd(-1) {}
    
    ~TCPServer() {
        if (server_fd >= 0) {
            close(server_fd);
        }
    }
    
    bool start() {
        // 1. 创建socket
        server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (server_fd < 0) {
            std::cerr << "socket() failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        // 2. 设置socket选项（地址重用）
        int opt = 1;
        if (setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt)) < 0) {
            std::cerr << "setsockopt() failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        // 3. 绑定地址和端口
        sockaddr_in address;
        memset(&address, 0, sizeof(address));
        address.sin_family = AF_INET;
        address.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;  // 监听所有网卡
        address.sin_port = htons(port);
        
        if (bind(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&address, sizeof(address)) < 0) {
            std::cerr << "bind() failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        // 4. 监听
        if (listen(server_fd, SOMAXCONN) < 0) {
            std::cerr << "listen() failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        std::cout << "Server listening on port " << port << std::endl;
        return true;
    }
    
    void run() {
        while (true) {
            sockaddr_in client_addr;
            socklen_t client_len = sizeof(client_addr);
            
            // 5. 接受连接
            int client_fd = accept(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&client_addr, &client_len);
            if (client_fd < 0) {
                std::cerr << "accept() failed" << std::endl;
                continue;
            }
            
            // 获取客户端信息
            char client_ip[INET_ADDRSTRLEN];
            inet_ntop(AF_INET, &client_addr.sin_addr, client_ip, sizeof(client_ip));
            int client_port = ntohs(client_addr.sin_port);
            std::cout << "Client connected: " << client_ip << ":" << client_port << std::endl;
            
            // 处理客户端（单线程版本）
            handleClient(client_fd);
        }
    }
    
private:
    void handleClient(int client_fd) {
        char buffer[4096];
        
        while (true) {
            // 6. 接收数据
            ssize_t n = recv(client_fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer) - 1, 0);
            if (n <= 0) {
                if (n == 0) {
                    std::cout << "Client disconnected" << std::endl;
                } else {
                    std::cerr << "recv() failed" << std::endl;
                }
                break;
            }
            
            buffer[n] = '\0';
            std::cout << "Received: " << buffer << std::endl;
            
            // 7. 发送数据（回显）
            if (send(client_fd, buffer, n, 0) < 0) {
                std::cerr << "send() failed" << std::endl;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        // 8. 关闭连接
        close(client_fd);
    }
};

/**
 * TCP客户端
 */
class TCPClient {
private:
    int sock_fd;
    std::string server_ip;
    int server_port;
    
public:
    TCPClient(const std::string& ip, int port) 
        : sock_fd(-1), server_ip(ip), server_port(port) {}
    
    ~TCPClient() {
        if (sock_fd >= 0) {
            close(sock_fd);
        }
    }
    
    bool connect() {
        // 1. 创建socket
        sock_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (sock_fd < 0) {
            std::cerr << "socket() failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        // 2. 连接服务器
        sockaddr_in server_addr;
        memset(&server_addr, 0, sizeof(server_addr));
        server_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
        server_addr.sin_port = htons(server_port);
        
        if (inet_pton(AF_INET, server_ip.c_str(), &server_addr.sin_addr) <= 0) {
            std::cerr << "Invalid address" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        if (::connect(sock_fd, (sockaddr*)&server_addr, sizeof(server_addr)) < 0) {
            std::cerr << "connect() failed" << std::endl;
            return false;
        }
        
        std::cout << "Connected to " << server_ip << ":" << server_port << std::endl;
        return true;
    }
    
    bool sendData(const std::string& data) {
        ssize_t n = send(sock_fd, data.c_str(), data.length(), 0);
        return n == (ssize_t)data.length();
    }
    
    std::string receiveData() {
        char buffer[4096];
        ssize_t n = recv(sock_fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer) - 1, 0);
        if (n > 0) {
            buffer[n] = '\0';
            return std::string(buffer);
        }
        return "";
    }
};

/**
 * UDP服务器
 */
class UDPServer {
private:
    int sock_fd;
    int port;
    
public:
    UDPServer(int port) : port(port), sock_fd(-1) {}
    
    ~UDPServer() {
        if (sock_fd >= 0) {
            close(sock_fd);
        }
    }
    
    bool start() {
        // UDP使用SOCK_DGRAM
        sock_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
        if (sock_fd < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        sockaddr_in address;
        memset(&address, 0, sizeof(address));
        address.sin_family = AF_INET;
        address.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
        address.sin_port = htons(port);
        
        if (bind(sock_fd, (sockaddr*)&address, sizeof(address)) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        std::cout << "UDP Server listening on port " << port << std::endl;
        return true;
    }
    
    void run() {
        char buffer[4096];
        sockaddr_in client_addr;
        socklen_t client_len = sizeof(client_addr);
        
        while (true) {
            // UDP使用recvfrom
            ssize_t n = recvfrom(sock_fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer) - 1, 0,
                                (sockaddr*)&client_addr, &client_len);
            if (n > 0) {
                buffer[n] = '\0';
                std::cout << "Received: " << buffer << std::endl;
                
                // UDP使用sendto
                sendto(sock_fd, buffer, n, 0,
                      (sockaddr*)&client_addr, client_len);
            }
        }
    }
};

14.2 IO多路复用：select

/**
 * select - IO多路复用
 * 可以同时监听多个文件描述符
 */

#include <sys/select.h>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

class SelectServer {
private:
    int server_fd;
    int port;
    std::vector<int> client_fds;
    
public:
    SelectServer(int port) : port(port), server_fd(-1) {}
    
    bool start() {
        server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (server_fd < 0) return false;
        
        int opt = 1;
        setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
        
        sockaddr_in address;
        memset(&address, 0, sizeof(address));
        address.sin_family = AF_INET;
        address.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
        address.sin_port = htons(port);
        
        if (bind(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&address, sizeof(address)) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if (listen(server_fd, SOMAXCONN) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        std::cout << "Select server listening on port " << port << std::endl;
        return true;
    }
    
    void run() {
        while (true) {
            fd_set read_fds;
            FD_ZERO(&read_fds);
            
            // 添加监听socket
            FD_SET(server_fd, &read_fds);
            int max_fd = server_fd;
            
            // 添加客户端socket
            for (int fd : client_fds) {
                FD_SET(fd, &read_fds);
                max_fd = std::max(max_fd, fd);
            }
            
            // select等待事件
            // 参数：最大fd+1, 读fd集合, 写fd集合, 异常fd集合, 超时时间
            int ret = select(max_fd + 1, &read_fds, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
            
            if (ret < 0) {
                std::cerr << "select() failed" << std::endl;
                break;
            }
            
            // 检查监听socket（新连接）
            if (FD_ISSET(server_fd, &read_fds)) {
                sockaddr_in client_addr;
                socklen_t client_len = sizeof(client_addr);
                int client_fd = accept(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&client_addr, &client_len);
                
                if (client_fd >= 0) {
                    client_fds.push_back(client_fd);
                    std::cout << "New client connected, fd=" << client_fd << std::endl;
                }
            }
            
            // 检查客户端socket（数据到达）
            for (auto it = client_fds.begin(); it != client_fds.end(); ) {
                int fd = *it;
                
                if (FD_ISSET(fd, &read_fds)) {
                    char buffer[4096];
                    ssize_t n = recv(fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0);
                    
                    if (n <= 0) {
                        // 连接关闭或错误
                        std::cout << "Client disconnected, fd=" << fd << std::endl;
                        close(fd);
                        it = client_fds.erase(it);
                    } else {
                        buffer[n] = '\0';
                        std::cout << "Received from fd=" << fd << ": " << buffer << std::endl;
                        
                        // 回显
                        send(fd, buffer, n, 0);
                        ++it;
                    }
                } else {
                    ++it;
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

/**
 * select的限制：
 * 1. 最大监听数量有限（通常是1024）
 * 2. 性能随fd数量线性下降
 * 3. 需要遍历所有fd检查事件
 */

14.3 IO多路复用：poll

/**
 * poll - IO多路复用
 * 改进了select的一些限制
 */

#include <poll.h>
#include <vector>

class PollServer {
private:
    int server_fd;
    int port;
    std::vector<pollfd> poll_fds;
    
public:
    PollServer(int port) : port(port), server_fd(-1) {}
    
    bool start() {
        server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (server_fd < 0) return false;
        
        int opt = 1;
        setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
        
        sockaddr_in address;
        memset(&address, 0, sizeof(address));
        address.sin_family = AF_INET;
        address.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
        address.sin_port = htons(port);
        
        if (bind(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&address, sizeof(address)) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if (listen(server_fd, SOMAXCONN) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // 添加监听socket到poll数组
        pollfd pfd;
        pfd.fd = server_fd;
        pfd.events = POLLIN;  // 监听可读事件
        poll_fds.push_back(pfd);
        
        std::cout << "Poll server listening on port " << port << std::endl;
        return true;
    }
    
    void run() {
        while (true) {
            // poll等待事件
            // 参数：pollfd数组, 数组大小, 超时时间(-1表示永久等待)
            int ret = poll(poll_fds.data(), poll_fds.size(), -1);
            
            if (ret < 0) {
                std::cerr << "poll() failed" << std::endl;
                break;
            }
            
            // 遍历所有fd
            for (size_t i = 0; i < poll_fds.size(); ++i) {
                if (poll_fds[i].revents & POLLIN) {
                    if (poll_fds[i].fd == server_fd) {
                        // 监听socket有新连接
                        sockaddr_in client_addr;
                        socklen_t client_len = sizeof(client_addr);
                        int client_fd = accept(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&client_addr, &client_len);
                        
                        if (client_fd >= 0) {
                            pollfd pfd;
                            pfd.fd = client_fd;
                            pfd.events = POLLIN;
                            poll_fds.push_back(pfd);
                            std::cout << "New client connected, fd=" << client_fd << std::endl;
                        }
                    } else {
                        // 客户端socket有数据
                        int fd = poll_fds[i].fd;
                        char buffer[4096];
                        ssize_t n = recv(fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0);
                        
                        if (n <= 0) {
                            // 连接关闭
                            std::cout << "Client disconnected, fd=" << fd << std::endl;
                            close(fd);
                            poll_fds.erase(poll_fds.begin() + i);
                            --i;  // 调整索引
                        } else {
                            buffer[n] = '\0';
                            std::cout << "Received: " << buffer << std::endl;
                            send(fd, buffer, n, 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

/**
 * poll vs select:
 * 优点：
 * 1. 没有最大fd数量限制
 * 2. pollfd结构更清晰
 * 
 * 缺点：
 * 1. 仍然需要遍历所有fd
 * 2. 性能随fd数量线性下降
 */

14.4 IO多路复用：epoll（Linux）

/**
 * epoll - Linux高性能IO多路复用
 * 只在Linux平台可用
 */

#include <sys/epoll.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unordered_map>

/**
 * 设置非阻塞模式
 */
bool setNonBlocking(int fd) {
    int flags = fcntl(fd, F_GETFL, 0);
    if (flags < 0) return false;
    return fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK) >= 0;
}

class EpollServer {
private:
    int server_fd;
    int epoll_fd;
    int port;
    
    static const int MAX_EVENTS = 1024;
    epoll_event events[MAX_EVENTS];
    
public:
    EpollServer(int port) : port(port), server_fd(-1), epoll_fd(-1) {}
    
    ~EpollServer() {
        if (epoll_fd >= 0) close(epoll_fd);
        if (server_fd >= 0) close(server_fd);
    }
    
    bool start() {
        // 1. 创建监听socket
        server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (server_fd < 0) return false;
        
        int opt = 1;
        setsockopt(server_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
        
        // 设置非阻塞
        setNonBlocking(server_fd);
        
        sockaddr_in address;
        memset(&address, 0, sizeof(address));
        address.sin_family = AF_INET;
        address.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
        address.sin_port = htons(port);
        
        if (bind(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&address, sizeof(address)) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if (listen(server_fd, SOMAXCONN) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // 2. 创建epoll实例
        epoll_fd = epoll_create1(0);
        if (epoll_fd < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // 3. 添加监听socket到epoll
        epoll_event ev;
        ev.events = EPOLLIN | EPOLLET;  // 边缘触发模式
        ev.data.fd = server_fd;
        
        if (epoll_ctl(epoll_fd, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, server_fd, &ev) < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        std::cout << "Epoll server listening on port " << port << std::endl;
        return true;
    }
    
    void run() {
        while (true) {
            // 4. 等待事件
            // 参数：epoll实例, 事件数组, 最大事件数, 超时时间
            int n = epoll_wait(epoll_fd, events, MAX_EVENTS, -1);
            
            if (n < 0) {
                std::cerr << "epoll_wait() failed" << std::endl;
                break;
            }
            
            // 5. 处理事件
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (events[i].data.fd == server_fd) {
                    // 新连接
                    handleNewConnection();
                } else {
                    // 客户端数据
                    handleClientData(events[i].data.fd);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
private:
    void handleNewConnection() {
        while (true) {
            sockaddr_in client_addr;
            socklen_t client_len = sizeof(client_addr);
            int client_fd = accept(server_fd, (sockaddr*)&client_addr, &client_len);
            
            if (client_fd < 0) {
                if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
                    // 所有连接都已处理
                    break;
                }
                std::cerr << "accept() failed" << std::endl;
                break;
            }
            
            // 设置非阻塞
            setNonBlocking(client_fd);
            
            // 添加到epoll
            epoll_event ev;
            ev.events = EPOLLIN | EPOLLET;  // 边缘触发
            ev.data.fd = client_fd;
            
            if (epoll_ctl(epoll_fd, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, client_fd, &ev) < 0) {
                close(client_fd);
                continue;
            }
            
            char client_ip[INET_ADDRSTRLEN];
            inet_ntop(AF_INET, &client_addr.sin_addr, client_ip, sizeof(client_ip));
            std::cout << "New client: " << client_ip << ", fd=" << client_fd << std::endl;
        }
    }
    
    void handleClientData(int fd) {
        char buffer[4096];
        
        while (true) {
            ssize_t n = recv(fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0);
            
            if (n > 0) {
                buffer[n] = '\0';
                std::cout << "Received from fd=" << fd << ": " << buffer << std::endl;
                
                // 回显
                send(fd, buffer, n, 0);
            } else if (n == 0) {
                // 连接关闭
                std::cout << "Client disconnected, fd=" << fd << std::endl;
                epoll_ctl(epoll_fd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, fd, nullptr);
                close(fd);
                break;
            } else {
                if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
                    // 数据读取完毕
                    break;
                }
                // 错误
                std::cerr << "recv() failed" << std::endl;
                epoll_ctl(epoll_fd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, fd, nullptr);
                close(fd);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
};

/**
 * epoll的优势：
 * 1. 没有fd数量限制
 * 2. 性能不随fd数量增加而降低（O(1)）
 * 3. 只返回就绪的fd，不需要遍历
 * 4. 支持边缘触发（ET）和水平触发（LT）
 * 
 * epoll触发模式：
 * LT（水平触发）：默认模式，只要有数据就通知
 * ET（边缘触发）：只在状态变化时通知一次，需要一次性读完所有数据
 * 
 * epoll操作：
 * EPOLL_CTL_ADD：添加fd
 * EPOLL_CTL_MOD：修改fd事件
 * EPOLL_CTL_DEL：删除fd
 * 
 * epoll事件：
 * EPOLLIN：可读
 * EPOLLOUT：可写
 * EPOLLET：边缘触发
 * EPOLLONESHOT：只触发一次
 */

14.5 高性能网络库框架

/**
 * 简化版Reactor模式网络库
 */

#include <memory>
#include <functional>
#include <thread>
#include <queue>

// 连接类
class Connection : public std::enable_shared_from_this<Connection> {
private:
    int fd;
    std::function<void(std::shared_ptr<Connection>)> onMessage;
    std::function<void(std::shared_ptr<Connection>)> onClose;
    
public:
    Connection(int fd) : fd(fd) {}
    
    ~Connection() {
        if (fd >= 0) {
            close(fd);
        }
    }
    
    void setMessageCallback(std::function<void(std::shared_ptr<Connection>)> cb) {
        onMessage = cb;
    }
    
    void setCloseCallback(std::function<void(std::shared_ptr<Connection>)> cb) {
        onClose = cb;
    }
    
    int getFd() const { return fd; }
    
    std::string receive() {
        char buffer[4096];
        ssize_t n = recv(fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer), 0);
        if (n > 0) {
            return std::string(buffer, n);
        }
        return "";
    }
    
    void send(const std::string& data) {
        ::send(fd, data.c_str(), data.length(), 0);
    }
    
    void handleRead() {
        if (onMessage) {
            onMessage(shared_from_this());
        }
    }
    
    void handleClose() {
        if (onClose) {
            onClose(shared_from_this());
        }
    }
};

// Reactor网络库
class EventLoop {
private:
    int epoll_fd;
    bool running;
    std::unordered_map<int, std::shared_ptr<Connection>> connections;
    
public:
    EventLoop() : running(false) {
        epoll_fd = epoll_create1(0);
    }
    
    ~EventLoop() {
        if (epoll_fd >= 0) {
            close(epoll_fd);
        }
    }
    
    void addConnection(std::shared_ptr<Connection> conn) {
        int fd = conn->getFd();
        connections[fd] = conn;
        
        epoll_event ev;
        ev.events = EPOLLIN | EPOLLET;
        ev.data.fd = fd;
        epoll_ctl(epoll_fd, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, fd, &ev);
    }
    
    void removeConnection(int fd) {
        epoll_ctl(epoll_fd, EPOLL_CTL_DEL, fd, nullptr);
        connections.erase(fd);
    }
    
    void loop() {
        running = true;
        epoll_event events[1024];
        
        while (running) {
            int n = epoll_wait(epoll_fd, events, 1024, -1);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                int fd = events[i].data.fd;
                auto it = connections.find(fd);
                
                if (it != connections.end()) {
                    auto conn = it->second;
                    
                    if (events[i].events & EPOLLIN) {
                        conn->handleRead();
                    }
                    
                    // 可以添加EPOLLOUT、EPOLLERR等处理
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    void stop() {
        running = false;
    }
};

// 使用示例
void network_framework_demo() {
    EventLoop loop;
    
    // 创建服务器socket
    int server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    // ... 绑定、监听 ...
    
    // 在独立线程中运行事件循环
    std::thread loop_thread([&loop]() {
        loop.loop();
    });
    
    // 接受连接并添加到事件循环
    while (true) {
        int client_fd = accept(server_fd, nullptr, nullptr);
        auto conn = std::make_shared<Connection>(client_fd);
        
        conn->setMessageCallback([](std::shared_ptr<Connection> c) {
            std::string data = c->receive();
            std::cout << "Received: " << data << std::endl;
            c->send(data);  // 回显
        });
        
        conn->setCloseCallback([&loop](std::shared_ptr<Connection> c) {
            std::cout << "Connection closed" << std::endl;
            loop.removeConnection(c->getFd());
        });
        
        loop.addConnection(conn);
    }
    
    loop_thread.join();
}

14.6 IO多路复用对比总结

/**
 * select vs poll vs epoll 对比
 * 
 * ┌─────────┬────────────────┬────────────────┬────────────────┐
 * │ 特性    │ select         │ poll           │ epoll          │
 * ├─────────┼────────────────┼────────────────┼────────────────┤
 * │ 最大fd  │ 1024（FD_SET） │ 无限制         │ 无限制         │
 * │ 性能    │ O(n)           │ O(n)           │ O(1)           │
 * │ 数据结构│ bitmap         │ pollfd数组     │ 红黑树+链表    │
 * │ 触发方式│ 水平触发       │ 水平触发       │ LT和ET         │
 * │ 跨平台  │ 是             │ 是             │ 否（仅Linux）  │
 * │ 内核拷贝│ 每次都需要     │ 每次都需要     │ 只拷贝就绪fd   │
 * └─────────┴────────────────┴────────────────┴────────────────┘
 * 
 * 使用建议：
 * - 少量连接（<100）：select/poll
 * - 大量连接：epoll
 * - 跨平台：select/poll
 * - 高性能Linux服务器：epoll
 */

/**
 * Windows平台：IOCP（完成端口）
 * macOS/BSD：kqueue
 */

#ifdef __APPLE__
// macOS kqueue示例
#include <sys/event.h>

class KqueueServer {
private:
    int kq;
    int server_fd;
    
public:
    bool start() {
        // 创建kqueue
        kq = kqueue();
        if (kq < 0) return false;
        
        // 创建监听socket
        server_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        // ... 绑定监听 ...
        
        // 添加监听事件
        struct kevent ev;
        EV_SET(&ev, server_fd, EVFILT_READ, EV_ADD, 0, 0, nullptr);
        kevent(kq, &ev, 1, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
        
        return true;
    }
    
    void run() {
        struct kevent events[1024];
        
        while (true) {
            int n = kevent(kq, nullptr, 0, events, 1024, nullptr);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (events[i].ident == (uintptr_t)server_fd) {
                    // 新连接
                    int client_fd = accept(server_fd, nullptr, nullptr);
                    
                    struct kevent ev;
                    EV_SET(&ev, client_fd, EVFILT_READ, EV_ADD, 0, 0, nullptr);
                    kevent(kq, &ev, 1, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
                } else {
                    // 客户端数据
                    int fd = events[i].ident;
                    // 处理数据...
                }
            }
        }
    }
};
#endif

第十五章：高级多线程编程

15.1 线程池进阶

/**
 * 高级线程池实现
 * 支持任务优先级、动态调整线程数、任务统计等
 */

#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <queue>
#include <functional>
#include <future>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>

class AdvancedThreadPool {
private:
    // 任务结构
    struct Task {
        std::function<void()> func;
        int priority;
        
        bool operator<(const Task& other) const {
            return priority < other.priority;  // 优先队列大顶堆
        }
    };
    
    std::vector<std::thread> workers;
    std::priority_queue<Task> tasks;
    
    mutable std::mutex queue_mutex;
    std::condition_variable condition;
    std::atomic<bool> stop;
    std::atomic<int> idle_threads;
    std::atomic<int> total_tasks;
    
    // 动态调整参数
    size_t min_threads;
    size_t max_threads;
    std::chrono::seconds thread_timeout;
    
public:
    AdvancedThreadPool(size_t min_threads = 4, 
                      size_t max_threads = 16,
                      std::chrono::seconds timeout = std::chrono::seconds(60))
        : stop(false)
        , idle_threads(0)
        , total_tasks(0)
        , min_threads(min_threads)
        , max_threads(max_threads)
        , thread_timeout(timeout) {
        
        // 创建最小线程数
        for (size_t i = 0; i < min_threads; ++i) {
            addWorker();
        }
    }
    
    ~AdvancedThreadPool() {
        stop = true;
        condition.notify_all();
        
        for (std::thread& worker : workers) {
            if (worker.joinable()) {
                worker.join();
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 提交任务（带优先级）
    template<typename F, typename... Args>
    auto submit(int priority, F&& f, Args&&... args) 
        -> std::future<typename std::result_of<F(Args...)>::type> {
        
        using return_type = typename std::result_of<F(Args...)>::type;
        
        auto task = std::make_shared<std::packaged_task<return_type()>>(
            std::bind(std::forward<F>(f), std::forward<Args>(args)...)
        );
        
        std::future<return_type> res = task->get_future();
        
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(queue_mutex);
            
            if (stop) {
                throw std::runtime_error("ThreadPool is stopped");
            }
            
            tasks.push(Task{[task]() { (*task)(); }, priority});
            ++total_tasks;
        }
        
        // 动态调整线程数
        adjustThreads();
        
        condition.notify_one();
        return res;
    }
    
    // 获取统计信息
    size_t getThreadCount() const {
        return workers.size();
    }
    
    size_t getIdleThreadCount() const {
        return idle_threads.load();
    }
    
    size_t getTaskCount() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(queue_mutex);
        return tasks.size();
    }
    
    size_t getTotalTasksProcessed() const {
        return total_tasks.load();
    }
    
private:
    void addWorker() {
        workers.emplace_back([this] {
            while (true) {
                Task task;
                
                {
                    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(queue_mutex);
                    
                    ++idle_threads;
                    
                    // 等待任务或超时
                    bool timeout = !condition.wait_for(lock, thread_timeout, [this] {
                        return stop || !tasks.empty();
                    });
                    
                    --idle_threads;
                    
                    // 超时且线程数超过最小值，退出线程
                    if (timeout && workers.size() > min_threads) {
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    if (stop && tasks.empty()) {
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    if (!tasks.empty()) {
                        task = std::move(const_cast<Task&>(tasks.top()));
                        tasks.pop();
                    }
                }
                
                if (task.func) {
                    task.func();
                }
            }
        });
    }
    
    void adjustThreads() {
        size_t current_threads = workers.size();
        size_t pending_tasks = tasks.size();
        size_t idle = idle_threads.load();
        
        // 如果任务多且空闲线程少，增加线程
        if (pending_tasks > idle && current_threads < max_threads) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(queue_mutex);
            if (workers.size() < max_threads) {
                addWorker();
            }
        }
    }
};

// 使用示例
void advanced_threadpool_demo() {
    AdvancedThreadPool pool(2, 8);
    
    std::vector<std::future<int>> results;
    
    // 提交不同优先级的任务
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
        int priority = i % 3;  // 优先级0-2
        results.push_back(pool.submit(priority, [i] {
            std::cout << "Task " << i << " running\n";
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
            return i * i;
        }));
    }
    
    // 输出统计信息
    std::cout << "Thread count: " << pool.getThreadCount() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Idle threads: " << pool.getIdleThreadCount() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Pending tasks: " << pool.getTaskCount() << "\n";
    
    // 等待结果
    for (auto& result : results) {
        std::cout << "Result: " << result.get() << "\n";
    }
    
    std::cout << "Total tasks processed: " << pool.getTotalTasksProcessed() << "\n";
}

15.2 无锁编程

/**
 * 无锁数据结构
 * 使用CAS（Compare-And-Swap）实现
 */

#include <atomic>

/**
 * 无锁栈
 */
template<typename T>
class LockFreeStack {
private:
    struct Node {
        T data;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& data) : data(data), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    
    std::atomic<Node*> head;
    
public:
    LockFreeStack() : head(nullptr) {}
    
    ~LockFreeStack() {
        while (Node* node = head.load()) {
            head.store(node->next);
            delete node;
        }
    }
    
    void push(const T& data) {
        Node* new_node = new Node(data);
        new_node->next = head.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        
        // CAS循环
        while (!head.compare_exchange_weak(new_node->next, new_node,
                                          std::memory_order_release,
                                          std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            // 如果失败，new_node->next已被更新为当前head值
            // 继续尝试
        }
    }
    
    bool pop(T& result) {
        Node* old_head = head.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        
        while (old_head && 
               !head.compare_exchange_weak(old_head, old_head->next,
                                          std::memory_order_acquire,
                                          std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            // 重试
        }
        
        if (old_head) {
            result = old_head->data;
            delete old_head;
            return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
};

/**
 * 无锁队列（MPMC - Multiple Producer Multiple Consumer）
 */
template<typename T>
class LockFreeQueue {
private:
    struct Node {
        T data;
        std::atomic<Node*> next;
        Node() : next(nullptr) {}
        Node(const T& data) : data(data), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    
    std::atomic<Node*> head;
    std::atomic<Node*> tail;
    
public:
    LockFreeQueue() {
        Node* dummy = new Node();
        head.store(dummy);
        tail.store(dummy);
    }
    
    ~LockFreeQueue() {
        while (Node* node = head.load()) {
            head.store(node->next);
            delete node;
        }
    }
    
    void enqueue(const T& data) {
        Node* new_node = new Node(data);
        
        while (true) {
            Node* last = tail.load();
            Node* next = last->next.load();
            
            if (last == tail.load()) {
                if (next == nullptr) {
                    if (last->next.compare_exchange_weak(next, new_node)) {
                        tail.compare_exchange_weak(last, new_node);
                        return;
                    }
                } else {
                    tail.compare_exchange_weak(last, next);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    bool dequeue(T& result) {
        while (true) {
            Node* first = head.load();
            Node* last = tail.load();
            Node* next = first->next.load();
            
            if (first == head.load()) {
                if (first == last) {
                    if (next == nullptr) {
                        return false;  // 队列为空
                    }
                    tail.compare_exchange_weak(last, next);
                } else {
                    result = next->data;
                    if (head.compare_exchange_weak(first, next)) {
                        delete first;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

/**
 * ABA问题和解决方案
 */
template<typename T>
class ABAFreeLockFreeStack {
private:
    struct Node {
        T data;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& data) : data(data), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    
    struct TaggedPointer {
        Node* ptr;
        uintptr_t tag;
    };
    
    std::atomic<TaggedPointer> head;
    
public:
    ABAFreeLockFreeStack() {
        head.store({nullptr, 0});
    }
    
    void push(const T& data) {
        Node* new_node = new Node(data);
        TaggedPointer old_head = head.load();
        
        do {
            new_node->next = old_head.ptr;
        } while (!head.compare_exchange_weak(
            old_head, 
            {new_node, old_head.tag + 1}));  // 增加tag解决ABA问题
    }
    
    bool pop(T& result) {
        TaggedPointer old_head = head.load();
        
        do {
            if (!old_head.ptr) {
                return false;
            }
        } while (!head.compare_exchange_weak(
            old_head,
            {old_head.ptr->next, old_head.tag + 1}));
        
        result = old_head.ptr->data;
        delete old_head.ptr;
        return true;
    }
};

15.3 内存模型和内存顺序

/**
 * C++内存模型
 * 理解和使用内存顺序（memory order）
 */

#include <atomic>
#include <thread>

/**
 * 内存顺序类型：
 * 
 * 1. memory_order_relaxed：最宽松，只保证原子性
 * 2. memory_order_consume：读操作，依赖顺序（已弃用）
 * 3. memory_order_acquire：读操作，获取语义
 * 4. memory_order_release：写操作，释放语义
 * 5. memory_order_acq_rel：读写操作，获取-释放语义
 * 6. memory_order_seq_cst：顺序一致性（默认，最严格）
 */

// 示例1：自旋锁
class SpinLock {
private:
    std::atomic_flag flag = ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;
    
public:
    void lock() {
        while (flag.test_and_set(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            // 自旋等待
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    }
    
    void unlock() {
        flag.clear(std::memory_order_release);
    }
};

// 示例2：生产者-消费者（使用acquire-release）
class ProducerConsumer {
private:
    std::atomic<int> data{0};
    std::atomic<bool> ready{false};
    
public:
    // 生产者
    void produce(int value) {
        data.store(value, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        ready.store(true, std::memory_order_release);  // 释放语义
    }
    
    // 消费者
    int consume() {
        while (!ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {  // 获取语义
            std::this_thread::yield();
        }
        return data.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
};

// 示例3：双检锁单例（使用acquire-release）
class Singleton {
private:
    static std::atomic<Singleton*> instance;
    static std::mutex mtx;
    
    Singleton() = default;
    
public:
    static Singleton* getInstance() {
        Singleton* tmp = instance.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (tmp == nullptr) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
            tmp = instance.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            if (tmp == nullptr) {
                tmp = new Singleton();
                instance.store(tmp, std::memory_order_release);
            }
        }
        return tmp;
    }
};

std::atomic<Singleton*> Singleton::instance{nullptr};
std::mutex Singleton::mtx;

/**
 * 内存屏障（Memory Barrier/Fence）
 */
void memory_fence_demo() {
    std::atomic<int> x{0}, y{0};
    std::atomic<int> r1{0}, r2{0};
    
    // 线程1
    std::thread t1([&]() {
        x.store(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_release);  // 释放屏障
        y.store(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    });
    
    // 线程2
    std::thread t2([&]() {
        while (!y.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));
        std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_acquire);  // 获取屏障
        r1 = x.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    });
    
    t1.join();
    t2.join();
    
    // r1一定是1
}

15.4 读写锁实现

/**
 * 读写锁实现
 * 允许多个读者或一个写者
 */

class ReadWriteLock {
private:
    std::mutex mtx;
    std::condition_variable read_cv, write_cv;
    int readers{0};
    int writers{0};
    int write_waiters{0};
    
public:
    // 读锁
    void readLock() {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
        // 如果有写者或等待的写者，等待
        while (writers > 0 || write_waiters > 0) {
            read_cv.wait(lock);
        }
        ++readers;
    }
    
    void readUnlock() {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
        --readers;
        if (readers == 0) {
            write_cv.notify_one();  // 唤醒一个写者
        }
    }
    
    // 写锁
    void writeLock() {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
        ++write_waiters;
        // 等待所有读者和写者完成
        while (readers > 0 || writers > 0) {
            write_cv.wait(lock);
        }
        --write_waiters;
        ++writers;
    }
    
    void writeUnlock() {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
        --writers;
        // 优先唤醒写者
        if (write_waiters > 0) {
            write_cv.notify_one();
        } else {
            read_cv.notify_all();  // 唤醒所有读者
        }
    }
};

// RAII封装
class ReadLockGuard {
private:
    ReadWriteLock& lock;
    
public:
    ReadLockGuard(ReadWriteLock& l) : lock(l) {
        lock.readLock();
    }
    
    ~ReadLockGuard() {
        lock.readUnlock();
    }
};

class WriteLockGuard {
private:
    ReadWriteLock& lock;
    
public:
    WriteLockGuard(ReadWriteLock& l) : lock(l) {
        lock.writeLock();
    }
    
    ~WriteLockGuard() {
        lock.writeUnlock();
    }
};

// 使用示例
void rwlock_demo() {
    ReadWriteLock rwlock;
    std::vector<int> shared_data;
    
    // 读线程
    auto reader = [&]() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
            ReadLockGuard guard(rwlock);
            std::cout << "Reading: size=" << shared_data.size() << "\n";
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
        }
    };
    
    // 写线程
    auto writer = [&]() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            WriteLockGuard guard(rwlock);
            shared_data.push_back(i);
            std::cout << "Writing: " << i << "\n";
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(200));
        }
    };
    
    std::thread t1(reader);
    std::thread t2(reader);
    std::thread t3(writer);
    
    t1.join();
    t2.join();
    t3.join();
}
